programme.title: The Green Mile
programme.desc: Paul Edgecomb, the head guard of death row, just wants life for him, his colleagues and the condemned to be nice and easy. However, when John Coffee, a massive man convicted of brutally killing a pair of young sisters arrives, things start to get strange. Beyond his simple, naïve nature and a deathly fear of the dark, Coffey seems to possess a prodigious, supernatural gift. Paul begins to question whether Coffey was truly guilty of murdering the two girls.

programme.desc: A half-hour comedy by Paddy Houlihan, set in and around the mens shed in a village in Ireland. programme.desc: Its Erin Burnetts turn to step out front and try to maintain a viable viewer presence for CNN in the weekday news arena. But the former CNBC anchor wont worry about ratings for her hourlong general news program, comparing that burden to "death." Instead, shell concern herself with translating world events into relevant information for viewers, paying close attention to such topics as the Middle East and womens issues. "I want people to say that our show is smart. I want our show to be authentic", Burnett says in a promo. "I want our show to have courage". Left unsaid, of course, is that she wants her show to have a big audience, too.

programme.desc: Jamie shows how juicy steak and crispy fries are effortlessly achieved. He grills a wonderful piece of meat and serves it with twice-baked garlic sage potatoes. Also included are sweet and sour onions in thyme, caramelised pineapple tart, and more.

programme.title: James Martins Great British Adventure
programme.desc: James visits the capital of the balti - Birmingham. Here he meets acclaimed food critic, broadcaster, columnist and author, Grace Dent. Swapping the mini for a narrow boat, James takes in the culture, which saw an industrial revolution. Jamess trip down the stretch of the 35-mile canal system inspires him to cook his version of a chicken balti. Grace explores the revolution of Birmingham and its food scene by starting at the famous Balti Triangle.

programme.title: James Martins Great British Adventure
programme.desc: James travels to Nottingham, where he sets up his mobile kitchen in the middle of Sherwood Forest and cooks a Forest Pork Feast for long-time pal and Michelin award-winning restaurateur Sat Bains. James visits Keith Gascoigne, the inventor of a medal winning Para-Olympic bow. He learns the art of bow making, to practice for a surprise for Sat Bains. Feeling peckish, James cooks sausage rolls with crispy bacon, and a fruity dipping sauce.

programme.title: James Martins Great British Adventure
programme.desc: James Martins British adventure travels as far to the east of England as this journey will go, to Norfolk, where he is joined by his good old mate and top local chef, Galton Blackiston. They meet in Cromer, where Galton has a successful fish and chip shop, which inspires James to cook pan-fried cod with a warm tartar sauce on the beach. Then James heads to Norfolk Lavender to find out why it grows so well in this county and how its distilled for oil.

programme.title: James Martins Great British Adventure
programme.desc: No adventure around the UK would be complete without a trip to the capital city, London. James is checking out some of his old haunts and stopping in on Clare Smyths brand new restaurant Core for a bite to eat and a catch up with the worlds best female chef. Then high up on the rooftops of London, he cooks up spiced pigeon breast with dhal. Next, James ventures into south east London to a knife forgery in Peckham. He gets hands on in the process of making Japanese style knives.

programme.title: James Martins Great British Adventure
programme.desc: James is bringing his culinary tour of the UK to his neck of the woods as he spends precious time in his adopted home county of Hampshire. Hes taking his gun dog Cooper to a training session at Laverstoke before cooking an amazing seasonal dish of partridge with vegetables and a sloe gin sauce. James hangs out with his best friend Jody Scheckter, an ex-formula one racer with an epic car collection, and a surprising passion for buffalo mozzarella.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri dives into amped-up eats, from Nashville hot chicken at a coastal Georgia joint and savoury Vietnamese street food in a Calgary noodle bar.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri dives into a world of cultural cuisine with indigenous recipes; fry bread and pozole in Phoenix, Ariz.; authentic Argentine specialities in Boulder, Colo.; a kabob spot in Memphis, Tenn., marinates meats with Ethiopian flavour.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guys diving into an island-Italian mashup. In Massachusetts, he visits a joint presenting a plantain sandwich and wings gone bananas. In Colorado Springs, he hits a neighbourhood Italian spot serving up arancini and delicious veal.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri heads out to grab international flavours. Dishes include shawarma and salmon souvlaki in Santa Fe and Scandinavian specialties in Kansas City, Missouri. Plus, in El Paso, a tortilla factory turning out top-notch tamales and tostadas.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri crosses the Atlantic to dive into the many different cuisines of Barcelona, Spain. Here he samples Galician-style octopus and soup, traditional sausage and old-school Catalan cooking.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: This trip, Guy Fieri grabs some off-the-hook seafood and savoury sensations. In Lansing, a food truck dishes out shrimp burgers and a unique potato popper. In Tucson, a Bosnian restaurant fires up legit Eastern European specialities.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri is travelling the country and digging into awesome bird and beef. In Longmont, a fried chicken emporium serves up their specialty, along with unique chicharrones.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieris taking a tasty tour through Tuscany in Italy. In Montecatini Alto, a hillside seafood spot serves up a squid ink speciality and a Mediterranean prawn-artichoke mashup.

programme.title: Man v Food
programme.desc: Adam Richman continues his quest to find the best eats in the USA. Baltimore Maryland boasts a chowdown must: flame grilled beef sliced thin and piled high.

programme.title: Man v Food
programme.desc: Adam Richmans search for the countrys best grub takes him to Washington, DC. His first stop is Bens Chili Bowl. Bens chili is amazing, whether by bowl or over fries, burgers, or the legendary half-smoke.

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm
programme.desc: Molly Yeh is starting the new year with a bang: making her tangy English muffin jam rolls, satisfying miso salmon grain bowls, and harissa roasted carrot dip with seedy cheese crackers.

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm
programme.desc: Molly Yeh celebrates the Lunar New Year on the farm with a fabulous Chinese-inspired feast comprising dishes like orange chicken, pork dan dan noodles with tender bok choy, golden lucky baloney egg rolls, and sprinkly almond cookies.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: Ten passionate homebakers take part in a `bake off, which will test every aspect of their baking skills as they battle it out to be crowned the Great British Bake Offs Best Amateur Baker. Each week the bakers are put through three challenges. The competition kicks off with cake in the Cotswolds. The bakers tackle three increasingly difficult challenges, starting off with their signature bake.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins take the eight passionate home bakers who made it through the first round to Scone Palace near Perth to make biscuits and teatime treats.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: It is week three of the competition and the six remaining bakers are making bread in Kent. In the shadow of Sarre Windmill, the bakers will be kneading, proving and knocking back their dough under the watchful eye of baking writer Mary Berry and master baker Paul Hollywood.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: Its week four and the remaining five bakers have travelled to Bakewell in Derbyshire. This time the bakers are reinventing an often neglected British classic - the pudding.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: Its the penultimate round and as the travelling marquee pitches up in the Cornish village of Mousehole, its time for the bakers to get to grips with the most difficult of all baking skills - pastry. They bake their own versions of hearty British pies, get down to details with exquisite pastry canapes, and take a crash-course in crimping for this weeks surprise bake.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: Its the Grand Final and the last three surviving contestants face their biggest challenge yet - baking for the Bake Offs Afternoon Tea Party. In order to be crowned the victor, they will need to bring together all of their skills, making cakes, bread and pastry.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: Once again 12 new bakers don their aprons and head for the iconic tent in the heart of the British Countryside. The bakers first signature challenge is to make a Madeira cake and their first showstopper is the classic Black Forest gateau.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: There are 11 bakers left in the tent and they face the signature challenge of creating 24 biscotti. The technical challenge is arlettes and the showstopper is an edible biscuit box of 36 biscuits of a different flavour.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: Its bread week in the tent and the bakers must create quick breads for the signature challenge. The technical challenge is baguettes and for the showstopper, the bakers must make edible 3D bread sculptures.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: Theres nine bakers left in the tent and the signature challenge is French classic creme brulee. The technical challenge tasks the bakers with making a Spanische windtorte and the showstopper calls for a stack of tiered cheesecakes.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: For alternative ingredients week, the bakers must bake without sugar, gluten or dairy. The signature challenge requires sugar-free cakes, the technical challenge is gluten-free pittas and the showstopper calls for dairy-free ice cream rolls.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: Its pastry week and the bakers begin with frangipane tarts for the signature challenge. The technical challenge calls for the flaouna, a traditional cheese filled pastry from Cyprus. The showstopper is the classic 70s canape, vol au vents.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: In a `Bake Off first, the entire episode is devoted to the period of history that gave birth to modern baking, the Victorians. The signature challenge is a stalwart of the Victorian dinner table, Game Pie.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: The bakers have to be tested on Patisserie and what better time to do it than the quarter-finals? The five remaining bakers must work their way through a wide range of childhood favourites, delicate French fancies and a mountainous choux pastry masterpiece.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: The pressure is on as the remaining bakers must get to grips with the one of the most difficult ingredients, chocolate.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: Only three of the original twelve bakers remain. Theyve made it to the final. Over 27 challenges, theyve worked their way through every baking discipline Mary and Paul have thrown at them from cakes to bread, pastry to puddings, and biscuits to chocolate.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: In Miami, wild boar sausage and house-cured bacon, in Modesto, California, tacos and a sweet and savoury waffle, and in Stockton, California, an ex-NFL player slinging wings that score with the sauce.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: In Modesto, California, Portuguese sausage and a lights-out lamb burger, in Oakland, okra gumbo and a meatless spin on succulent sandwiches, and in Islamorada, Florida, wicked wings and righteous pork rinds.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri is diving into the pie. He starts in Boston to check out a beer-crust pizza and tops it with taco fixings. Also, he visits a funky joint serving a twist on apple pie in Reno, Nevada.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieris crisscrossing the nation to grab some international grub. In Dallas, a funky Thai joint serving up noodles, curry and green papaya salad. In Miami, a Latin place dealing in empanadas and a unique plantain sandwich.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieris flying with chicken and so much more. In Santa Barbara, a butcher is saucing up chicken tacos, while in Delray Beach, FL, an homage to mum includes a mouthwatering pasta. In Las Vegas, a chef is going over the top with Thai creations.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieris piling up the meat with a little sweet. In Santa Barbara, CA, a hidden gem is putting out funky fusion like Korean paella. In Florida, a Boynton Beach butcher is elevating porchetta. A Boca Raton food truck is cooking cheesecake in a jar.

programme.title: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: On a remote island, a wealthy entrepreneur creates a theme park featuring living dinosaurs drawn from prehistoric DNA. Before opening the attraction to the public, he invites a top palaeontologist, palaeobotanist, mathematician/theorist, and his two eager grandchildren to experience the park. Their park visit is anything but tranquil as the parks security system breaks down, and the prehistoric creatures break out.

programme.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Sequel in which the entrepreneur who genetically engineered the dinosaurs in Jurassic Park transpires to have cloned more of the prehistoric monsters on another island location. Researchers arrive to observe the creatures in their natural habitat, but hot on their heels is a band of mercenaries intent on capturing the dinosaurs and transporting them back to San Diego Zoo.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Dr Alan Grant reluctantly accompanies a rich couple who are searching for their teenage son who crashed on the second Jurassic Park island while paragliding. Unfortunately for the adventurers, there are many unfamiliar - and deadly - dinosaurs lurking in the jungle.

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Jurassic Park is now called Jurassic World, a fully functional dinosaur park that sees 20,000 visitors a year, the realisation of owner John Hammonds dreams. The scientists may have gone too far in creating some sort of hybrid dinosaur, which escapes and terrorises the park.

programme.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
programme.desc: Three years after the destruction of the Jurassic World theme park, Owen Grady and Claire Dearing return to the island of Isla Nublar to save the remaining dinosaurs from a volcano thats about to erupt.
